notes: Defined 5 stories covering schema, audit logic, API/UI exposure, automated scanning, and tests/integration for BRAND-001.

BRAND-001-S1.title: Define Brand Naming Schema and Audit Contract
BRAND-001-S1.description: Define the canonical naming contract enforcing 'ChatHealthy.ai' usage across all artifacts, including validation rules, allowed variants (none), and violation patterns (e.g., 'ChatHealthy' without .ai).

BRAND-001-S2.title: Implement Brand Audit Scanning Logic
BRAND-001-S2.description: Build core logic to scan codebase, Brain artifacts, and website content for naming violations using the defined schema and regex/pattern matching rules.

BRAND-001-S3.title: Expose Brand Audit Results via API and Developer Output
BRAND-001-S3.description: Provide an API and/or CLI output that returns audit results including file path, violation type, and suggested correction to 'ChatHealthy.ai'.

BRAND-001-S4.title: Automated Fix Suggestions and Reporting
BRAND-001-S4.description: Enhance audit output to include auto-fix suggestions and summary reports (counts, severity) to support rapid remediation without modifying files automatically.

BRAND-001-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Brand Audit
BRAND-001-S5.description: Create test suite validating detection of incorrect naming, correct handling of edge cases, and end-to-end scan-to-report workflow across representative artifacts.

BRAND-001.mitigation: Limit audit scope to pattern matching without modifying source files.
